name: Circle Internet Group, Inc.
moat_justification: USDC's compliance stack (GENIUS Act framework, OCC national trust charter, NYDFS charter, audited reserves) and institutional distribution are real advantages, but the float is a commodity, Tether's USDT is ~2.5x USDC and keeps ~100% of its reserve income while Circle keeps ~37% after distribution (Coinbase 50/50 share through Aug 2029), Tether's GENIUS-compliant USAT attacks the compliance home field, and revenue is the Fed-set Treasury yield on float with no pricing power.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 53.2%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share -0.23 vs 3-yr median 0.46 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Real regulatory moat (5/10) on a commodity float — TTM OE of $2.01/share is a 2.3% yield at $86.30 and even the super-bull case returns only 11.5%; clears 15% only at ~$25.
moat_for: Regulatory moat: GENIUS Act, OCC national trust charter, NYDFS charter, audited reserves
USDC network/distribution: $73.3B circulation, ~27% stablecoin share, Coinbase + institutional partners
Trust lead with regulated institutions that cannot use non-compliant tokens
moat_against: Tether USDT ~$184B (~60% share, ~2.5x USDC) keeps ~100% of reserve income vs Circle ~37%
Coinbase 50/50 revenue share through Aug 2029 hands core economics to a partner
Tether USAT (Jan 2026, GENIUS-compliant) plus PayPal/bank coins attack the compliance edge
No pricing power: ~95% of revenue is Fed-set reserve yield; GENIUS bars holder interest
